authorization.scope: Separate bounded diagnostic completion experiment. Existing q25 weights only, no paid calls or new model downloads; no preference training; no silent use of renewed quota.
authorization.source: Explicit user requests in this conversation on October4: run additional free Kaggle experiments; continue; use more compute if compute is the bottleneck.

data.encoding: Own tokenizer, no auto-special tokens; target plus tokenizer EOS, prompt masked, no label truncation. Prefix/suffix token slices may only remove remote context and must decode on UTF-8 boundaries.
data.mode_assignment: hash of content SHA and variant index modulo two; enumerate two variants per document, retain only distinct valid states
data.new_development_policy: Connected repository-alias groups wholly disjoint from previous 4096 training states. Order groups by SHA256 of seed and sorted aliases; language quotas fixed before model outputs. Reserve whole groups before selecting new training states.
data.new_state_matching_policy: Deterministic without replacement by language, total-input bins 1-128/129-256/257-512/513-768/769-1024 and response-including-EOS bins 1-8/9-16/17-32/33-64/65-96. Match previous4096 counts as far as eligible supply permits, then same-language nearest length bins and deterministic hash order. Report all shortages and actual input/target tokens; equal exposure does not establish equal FLOPs.
data.original_development_policy: Preserve exact original 240 rows separately, secondary historical comparison only; these outcomes have already been inspected.
data.prompt_format: PSM through existing tinycomplete.data.fim.format_psm, no chat template
data.repeat_training_policy: Retain exact previous 4096 states, two passes. No duplicate inflation of distinct-state counts.
data.scaled_training_policy: Retain every previous training row byte-for-byte as first 4096; append 4096 eligible distinct states using existing variant 0 and 1, frozen language quotas, no oversampling. No new variants.
data.source_order: sha256(seed, split, content SHA, variant) sorted; deterministic per-language allocation with no oversampling
data.task: synthetic one-line FIM completion; not observed next-edit intent
data.token_roundtrip: Require exact tokenizer decode of prompt and target IDs to original strings with special tokens retained and cleanup disabled; reject normalized or otherwise non-roundtripping states before deterministic allocation.
data.training_allocation: frozen language weights, deterministic quotas, no oversampling
data.validation: Exact source hash, unchanged region round trip, target application reconstructs full source; source-group split/dedup; no sealed fixtures read.

evaluation.decision: Use measured primary improvement and general regression. Lock selection before any further held-out evaluation. No claim of production accuracy.
evaluation.decoding: greedy; actual declared EOS; no parser repair, whitespace trim or selected truncation
evaluation.primary: Common new repository-disjoint 512-state development exact_and_terminated. Paired outcomes with repository-clustered bootstrap, 2000 samples, seed271828.
evaluation.secondary: Preserved original 240-state development, unchanged FIM line180, raw causal200 and raw line180. Scoring and fixtures unchanged.

limitations: Equal example exposures do not guarantee identical FLOPs because source lengths differ.
Synthetic source completion is not a human intent label.
No intermediate development snapshots from prior one-pass run establish saturation.
experiment.matched: Same untouched base, tokenizer, objective, optimizer, 512 updates and schedule; equal example exposure, actual input and target token counts reported separately.
experiment.matched_batch_schedule: Two4096-state stages with batch16. First-stage batches exactly the previous4096 batch order with seed314159 for both variants. Second-stage replay or new examples bucketed with seed314160. One global512-update LR schedule, no restart between stages.

revision_reason: Before preparation/model outputs, strengthen compute comparison by sharing the exact first 4096-state batch sequence, then matching new-state language and input/target-length bins to replay states. Distinct-state total stays8192, two variants/source max, no data expansion.

sources.split_membership: Only exact clean feeder documents in frozen CPT train/development manifests; related variants retain that split.
